== Biography ==
Magdalen Glasgow has an imported exact birth field of 29 January 1749 at West Calder; the newly reviewed derivative indexes label 29 January as her baptism and give only birth year 1749, so they do not independently verify that exact birth day. They name John Glasgow and Magdalen Guthrie as parents of the recorded child. The selected adult father [[Glasgow-81|John Glasgow]] is assessed at 64% (probable); the attached adult mother [[Guthrie-777|Magdalene Guthrie]] remains unassessed.
